target_customer: Local service businesses in North America such as trades and home services
problem: Small local businesses lack time to manage reviews, websites, leads and ads. OneLocal automates review requests and local marketing and pairs software with human marketing staff.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription with managed marketing services

founders.name: Edward Yao
founders.background_notes: Listed as Founder/CEO on the YC page; legal entity Gata Labs Inc. per a trademark listing seen in search.

technical_complexity.rationale: Review request automation and syncing with Google and Facebook is standard integration work. Later AI features add more complexity.

defensibility.rationale: Many similar local marketing tools exist and the product bundles services, so copying is easy; switching costs come from hosted websites and customer data.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition or copying found; the company remained independent.

market_need_then: Not established with dated sources. The early product, LocalReviews, automated review requests and syncing of reviews, per the company site.

branding.domain_note: Uses onelocal.com per the YC page.

identity.voice_and_tone: Confident and results-focused, plain language for busy small business owners

branding.brand_signature: Mission statement: make small business easy
branding.community_and_virality: Claims a 4.6 Google rating and 3,500 plus customers on its own site.

brand_strength.rationale: Clear plain-spoken voice but no press or community evidence about the brand, and the name is confusable with OwnLocal and others.

outcome_analysis: OneLocal grew from a YC S17 review automation tool into an all-in-one local marketing platform with about 90 people per the YC page and a claimed 3,500 plus local business customers. A Series A is reported but its date and size could not be verified from an opened source, so how strong the growth was remains partly unknown.
notes: A law firm announcement (lwlaw.com, seen only in a search snippet, page returned 404 on fetch) says OneLocal closed a Series A; CB Insights lists it as 2019-07-23 with undisclosed investors. Not recorded as a round because I could not open a source with its terms. The $120K figure on aggregators is the YC deal. Competitor list is empty because competitor names (Chatmeter, RevLocal) came from undated CB Insights comparison pages. Completeness pass: the Series A dated 2019-07-23 with undisclosed amount and investors is recorded from CB Insights alone; a law firm announcement (lwlaw.com) confirms a Series A closed but gives no date or amount. Total raised figures conflict across aggregators (120K, 410K) and are not summed.
